# 03b — Detailed prescription-order merge (SHORT)

[Full notebook](../notebooks/03b_merge_exposures.ipynb)

## Objective

Merge detailed qualifying order flags and check their aggregate distributions.

## Input

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd`
- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd_raas_detailed`

## Output and downstream use

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd_with_raas`
- Supports merge/distribution checks. The shared model loader instead reads extended outcomes and joins detailed exposure directly.

## Key methods and scope

- Executes `sql/03_merge_exposures.sql` using patient/admission/stay join keys.
- Both-class flags and legacy `is_monotherapy` labels describe order categories; they do not establish concurrent treatment or actual administration.
- Checks before/after row counts, missing exposure fields, exposure-group distributions, and aggregate flag totals.
- Run `sql/04_build_outcomes.sql` and then `sql/04_build_outcomes_extended.sql` after phase 03 and before any 04-series notebook. Those SQL scripts create the outcome tables; the 04-series notebooks do not. See [the dependency map](METHODS_OVERVIEW.md#outcome-table-dependencies).
